{{Quote|OH, and I should introduce you to an associate of mine from the Corellia Times. He is going to aid me with this story while I'm still recovering. Be sure to speak with him for guidance.|[[Vani Korr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" />}}
'''Halden Wes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] for the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What I mean is, this is a ''Corellia Times'' story and we deserve credit.  Our news isn't widely distributed off planet.  If a larger syndicated news service got wind of this I'd miss....I mean the ''Times'' would miss its chance.|Halden Wes, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Halden Wes was based in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. He assisted fellow reporter [[Vani Korr]] in her investigation of the fanatical technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminals.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he started to work with a spacer who previously worked with Vani Korr to identify the location of the [[Meatlump Hideout]].<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> Wes dispatched the spacer to find Meatlumps camps on Corellia but also outside their home planet. The adventurer discovered that the Meatlumps had established camps near the cities of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] and [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on Corellia, [[Nashal]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], and near [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] and [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Halden Wes and the spacer realized that the Meatlumps had gathered large amounts of supplies to those camps, including food, weapons and explosives. As it appeared that the criminals were planning important operations on those worlds, the spacer suggested warning the authorities, while the ambitious Wes argued they could get credit, and ''Corellia Times'' as well, for foiling the Meatlump plans. The reporter finally paid the adventurer a good price to raid the Meatlump camps. The spacer therefore traveled to those worlds, attacked the Meatlumps and sacked the camps.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halden Wes was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Halden Wes was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
